common.nothingToShow: Nothing to show in the {{view}} view.
form.name: Name
velero.backupNote: Velero backs up every object of {{namespace}} and, where it is set up for that, its volumes. The backup runs in Velero, not in Sextant.
velero.invalidName: Use lowercase letters, digits, dashes and dots, up to 63 characters.
velero.noLocations: No BackupStorageLocation was found: Velero may not be set up.
velero.ttlHint: A duration such as 720h0m0s (30 days, Velero's default); Velero deletes the backup after it.
velero.invalidTtl: Enter a duration such as 720h or 72h30m.
velero.restoreNote: Velero skips most objects that already exist (some kinds, such as ServiceAccounts, are merged) and counts them as warnings of the restore.
velero.restoreNoteMapped: Objects are restored into the namespaces you named. Velero skips most objects that already exist (some kinds, such as ServiceAccounts, are merged) and counts them as warnings of the restore.
velero.restoreNotCompleted: The backup's phase is {{phase}}, not Completed: the restore may fail or bring back only part of it.
velero.allNamespaces: The backup covers every namespace; each is restored under its own name.
velero.mappingHint: Leave a field empty to restore into the same namespace.
velero.invalidNamespace: Enter a namespace name: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
velero.explain.validationNoReason: Velero refused it as not valid.
velero.explain.failedNoReason: It failed; Velero gave no reason.
velero.explain.backupErrors_one: {{count}} error: some objects or volumes were not backed up.
velero.explain.backupErrors_other: {{count}} errors: some objects or volumes were not backed up.
velero.explain.restoreErrors_one: {{count}} error: some objects were not restored.
velero.explain.restoreErrors_other: {{count}} errors: some objects were not restored.
velero.explain.backupLogs: The details are in the log: velero backup logs {{name}}
velero.explain.restoreLogs: The details are in the log: velero restore logs {{name}}
velero.explain.paused: Paused: no new backups are made.
velero.explain.unavailable: Velero cannot reach this storage location: {{message}}
velero.explain.unavailableNoMessage: Velero cannot reach this storage location: check its credentials and bucket.
